newsitem.title: UK: Labour open minded on UK air traffic control - Brown.
newsitem.headline: Labour open minded on UK air traffic control - Brown.

text.p: The opposition Labour Party has an open mind on whether Britain's air traffic control system should be privatised, economics spokesman Gordon Brown said on Monday.
"We do not rule that out," Brown said in a BBC radio interview.
"We will look at it on its merits and there are safety considerations involved," Brown added.
He said the government had not published a promised White Paper, or policy document, on the issue and therefore Labour could not make a decision this side of the May 1 election.
"The test is the public interest, and that is the test we will apply across the board," he added. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5425528
